title: Access
summary: Request the accounts and permissions you need, and record who grants each.
verification: You can open the repository, the CI dashboard, and the work tracker.
body:
Request each system on day minus five if you can. Record who grants it and when
you asked.

variables.name: onboarding_owner_role
variables.description: Which role owns onboarding here? It appears as the owner of the Access section.

variables.name: access_request_url
variables.description: Where do people request source control access?

variables.name: repo_url
variables.description: What is the clone URL of the main repository?
variables.patternHint: A clone URL, starting with git@ or https://

variables.name: source_control_grantor
variables.description: Which role grants source control access?

variables.name: ci_grantor
variables.description: Which role grants CI dashboard access?

variables.name: tracker_grantor
variables.description: Which role grants work tracker access?

variables.name: account_name
variables.description: What is your account name at the organization?

checks.ask: Can you open the CI dashboard?
Can you open the work tracker?
